#import file
```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
cipro_BZB_1h <- read_excel("10.26_Cipro_BZB_testRun.xlsx", sheet="first_1h")
cipro_BZB_15h <- read_excel("10.26_Cipro_BZB_testRun.xlsx", sheet="second_15h")
key_ref <- read_excel("10.26_Cipro_BZB_testRun.xlsx", sheet="keys")
```

#clean and combine
```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr.")

cipro_BZB_1h$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_1h$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." + 90
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Time [s]" <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Time [s]" + 5400

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(cipro_BZB_1h, cipro_BZB_15h)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df %>%
  select(-3)%>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(`Time [s]`/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  rename(Cycle=`Cycle Nr.`,
         Time_s=`Time [s]`)%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())
  
```


#add a key col
```{r}
df_clean<- left_join(df_clean, key_ref[, c("well_ID", "key", "cipro_ug_mL", "trial", "trial_rep", "trial_ID")], by = "well_ID")

df_clean$cipro_ug_mL<-factor(as.numeric(df_clean$cipro_ug_mL))

```

#calculate mean from replicates
```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  filter(trial != "test") %>%
  group_by(Time_h, trial, cipro_ug_mL) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```


#plot curves
```{r} 
BZB_H_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(trial == "H") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = cipro_ug_mL, group =cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well; cipro-H2O stock",
        y="Mean OD")

BZB_H_curve

#set working directory before saving!
ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_testRun_H-H2O_102626.png", plot = BZB_H_curve, units="px", width = 600, height = 450, dpi = 120)
```

## plot out controls
```{r}
solvent_controls<- df_clean |>
   filter(trial_ID %in% c("GC_A","HCL_BZB", "H2O_BZB")) |>
ggplot(aes(x = Time_h, y = OD, color = trial_ID)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~trial_ID, nrow=3)+
   labs(title = "Curves for Experimental Controls",
        caption = str_wrap("GC_A: growth control with MHB; H2O_BZB: only cipro-H2O stock+BZB; HCL_BZB: only cipro-HCL stock+BZB"),
        y="OD")

solvent_controls

ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_testRun_solventControls_102626.png", plot = solvent_controls, units="px",width = 800, height = 650, dpi = 120)

```
